title: An unconditionally stable space-time isogeometric method for a biharmonic wave equation
summary: This work presents a space-time isogeometric analysis of biharmonic wave problem, in contrast to the more common application of space-time methods to second order wave equations. We first establish the unique solvability of the continuous space-time variational formulation. In order to obtain $H^2$- conforming discretization of the biharmonic wave equation, we consider globally smooth B-spline functions having continuity higher than $C^0$.
